spec.name: hook-workers-off-codex
spec.intent: Move canon's hook workers and their tests off codex. census @ 8753f969 (local://what-ships-census.md): 62 lines. deploy-drift-notice.test.ts proves the two-harness worker law ('a session reports on its own deployment; the other worker stays silent; a sibling tree is rejected by shape') with claude and omp instead of claude and codex. harness-independence.test.ts lists the supported homes and CLIs. Reword the codex comments in hooks/deploy-drift-notice.ts, hooks/stance-guardrail-pre.ts, manifest.ts, tooling/project-targets.ts and tooling/project.ts. Regenerate targets with `pnpm canon:project:targets` and commit only deploy-drift-notice.sh and stance-guardrail-pre.sh. Do not touch hooks/stance-guardrail.ts, because other units own it.
accept: `git grep -n -i codex -- <the 9 outputs>` prints nothing. At 8753f969 it prints 62.
deploy-drift-notice.test.ts still has a case where the second harness's drift wakes only its own worker, and one where that worker rejects the claude tree. Both run against omp.
After `pnpm canon:project:targets`, `git status --short packages/canon/targets` shows no change outside the two declared .sh outputs.
`pnpm build && pnpm --filter @cratylus/canon exec vitest run test/deploy-drift-notice.test.ts test/harness-independence.test.ts` is green, and `pnpm exec biome check` passes on the outputs.
